payload.question: How much council business is done online?
payload.label: Share of contact through digital channels, Q1 2025/26
payload.council_caveat: The council attributes the jump to "a higher demand for waste and refuse services because of customers accessing the bin checker due to the high number of bank holidays" — so this quarter is unusually high. The council publishes these numbers as screenshots of a dashboard inside a PDF, so they cannot be read by machine. We read them off the images by eye, which is why this measure is flagged for human checking.
payload.evidence: The council wants more than half of contact to happen online, and set the target at 53%. In the first quarter of 2025/26 it was 68.53%.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 8 September 2026
